_comment: AI coding tool cost model. Prices are USD before tax. Verify vendor sources before changing rates.

plans.label: Enterprise
plans.note: $20 per seat each month plus usage at API rates; annual commitment.

plans.label: Team Standard
plans.note: Includes an unpublished usage allowance. The result is an upper bound if every modelled token becomes paid extra usage.

plans.label: Team Premium
plans.note: Includes five times the Standard usage allowance. The result is an upper bound because the allowance is not published in tokens or dollars.

rates.label: Claude Sonnet 5
rates.note: Introductory rate through 31 August 2026; then $3/$15 input/output.

plans.label: Business
plans.note: Includes the standard 1,900 pooled AI credits per seat. One AI credit equals $0.01; temporary promotional credits are excluded.

plans.label: Enterprise
plans.note: Includes the standard 3,900 pooled AI credits per seat. One AI credit equals $0.01; temporary promotional credits are excluded.

plans.label: Teams Standard
plans.note: Includes separate first-party and third-party pools, with at least $20 of agent usage per Standard seat.

plans.label: Teams Premium
plans.note: Costs three times Standard and includes five times its usage. The calculator uses $100 as the minimum third-party allowance.

rates.label: Claude Sonnet 5
rates.note: Third-party API rate; introductory Sonnet 5 pricing through 31 August 2026.

plans.label: ChatGPT Business
plans.note: Includes ChatGPT and a baseline Codex allowance. The result is an upper bound because the included allowance is not published in credits.

plans.label: Enterprise flexible pricing
plans.note: Uses a contracted shared credit pool. Enter the team’s monthly-equivalent contract cost and included credits.

plans.label: Edu flexible pricing
plans.note: Uses an education contract and shared credit pool. Enter the team’s monthly-equivalent contract cost and included credits.

plans.label: Codex-only PAYG (eligible workspaces)
plans.note: No fixed seat fee. Available to Enterprise; Business is eligible only if the workspace added a Codex seat before 24 June 2026.

rates.label: GPT-5.6 Luna
rates.note: Converted from 25/2.5/150 credits per million tokens at $0.04 per credit.

rates.label: GPT-5.6 Terra
rates.note: Converted from 62.5/6.25/375 credits per million tokens at $0.04 per credit.

rates.label: GPT-5.6 Sol
rates.note: Converted from 125/12.5/750 credits per million tokens at $0.04 per credit.

plans.label: Individual
plans.note: Free access with a basic weekly quota ceiling and unlimited Tab completions. At the ceiling, wait for refresh or upgrade.

plans.label: Google AI Pro
plans.note: Higher included quota ceiling, refreshed every five hours until the weekly limit. At the ceiling, wait for refresh or purchase AI credits; regional annual discounts are not modelled.

plans.label: Google AI Ultra 5×
plans.note: Five times the Pro quota ceiling. At the ceiling, wait for refresh or purchase AI credits; no transferable token allowance is published.

plans.label: Google AI Ultra 20×
plans.note: Twenty times the Pro quota ceiling. At the ceiling, wait for refresh or purchase AI credits; no transferable token allowance is published.

plans.label: Organization via Google Cloud
plans.note: Consumption-based Google Cloud billing for Antigravity 2.0 and CLI; model, compute, memory and storage charges are not reduced to one public seat rate.

modelMixes.label: Economical
modelMixes.description: Routine work routed to efficient models

modelMixes.label: Balanced
modelMixes.description: Mostly standard models with selective escalation

modelMixes.label: Frontier-heavy
modelMixes.description: Frequent use of the most capable models

repositoryScales.label: Small (<100k LOC)
repositoryScales.description: Planning assumption: 25% less input context than the 100k–400k LOC baseline.

repositoryScales.label: Medium (100k–400k LOC)
repositoryScales.description: Neutral baseline, anchored around the repository scale represented in SWE-bench.

repositoryScales.label: Large (400k–2m LOC)
repositoryScales.description: Planning assumption: 10% more input with indexed or graph-based code search already configured.

repositoryScales.label: Very large (>2m LOC)
repositoryScales.description: Planning assumption: 20% more input with indexed or graph-based code search already configured; repository architecture can materially change this.

changeScopes.label: Narrow fix (≈15–35 lines)
changeScopes.description: Localised issue or repair, aligned with the central SWE-bench change-size range.

changeScopes.label: Typical PR (≈50–75 lines)
changeScopes.description: Neutral baseline, spanning reported medians of 55 agentic and 72 changed lines.

changeScopes.label: Broad change (≈75–200 lines)
changeScopes.description: Planning scenario for a multi-file change that needs more context, generation and verification.

changeScopes.label: Cross-cutting change (>200 lines)
changeScopes.description: Stress scenario for large or cross-cutting work; replace with pilot data where possible.

operatingModels.label: 1. Assisted development
operatingModels.description: Copilot-style suggestions and short chats; the developer implements and verifies.

operatingModels.label: 2. Spec-driven execution
operatingModels.description: An agent implements a defined outcome; a human reads and approves the result.

operatingModels.label: 3. Agent-native delivery
operatingModels.description: Agents build, test and perform initial review; humans own intent, architecture and release.
